literal: If one cuts off desire completely, the unfailing state will come in the very manner oneself wishes.
translation: If a person completely cuts off desire, the eternal, unfailing state of liberation will come to them in the very way they wish.
modern: ஆசையை முழுமையாக ஒழித்துவிட்டால், அழியாத பேரின்ப நிலை தான் விரும்பும் வழியிலேயே வந்து சேரும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the ultimate reward of conquering desire. The word 'அவாவினை' refers to desire, which binds the soul, and 'ஆற்ற அறுப்பின்' means to sever it completely. When desire is totally eliminated, 'தவாவினை'—the unfailing, eternal state of liberation or supreme peace—comes naturally. The phrase 'தான்வேண்டு மாற்றான்' (தான் வேண்டும் ஆற்றான்) indicates that this ultimate state will manifest in the exact manner that the seeker wishes, showing that true freedom brings absolute mastery over one's destiny.
